lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਜਿਨੀ ਆਪੁ ਤਜਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਵਾਸਨਾ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaadee jinee aap tajiaa har vaasanaa samaanee ||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, they shed their selfishness and conceit; their hopes are merged in the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਚਾਲ ਭਗਤਾ ਜੁਗਹੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਨਿਰਾਲੀ ॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: kahai naanak chaal bhagataa jugahu jug niraalee ||14||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, the lifestyle of the devotees, in each and every age, is unique and distinct. ||14||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਤੂ ਚਲਾਇਹਿ ਤਿਵ ਚਲਹ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹੋਰੁ ਕਿਆ ਜਾਣਾ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jiu too chalaaihi tiv chalah suaamee hor kiaa jaanaa gun tere ||
lines.translation: As You make me walk, so do I walk, O my Lord and Master; what else do I know of Your Glorious Virtues?

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਵ ਤੂ ਚਲਾਇਹਿ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਹ ਜਿਨਾ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਵਹੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jiv too chalaaihi tivai chalah jinaa maarag paavahe ||
lines.translation: As You cause them to walk, they walk - You have placed them on the Path.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਿਨ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਾਇਹਿ ਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਵਹੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar kirapaa jin naam laaihi s har har sadaa dhiaavahe ||
lines.translation: In Your Mercy, You attach them to the Naam; they meditate forever on the Lord, Har, Har.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣਾਇਹਿ ਆਪਣੀ ਸਿ ਗੁਰਦੁਆਰੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis no kathaa sunaaihi aapanee s guraduaarai sukh paavahe ||
lines.translation: Those whom You cause to listen to Your sermon, find peace in the Gurdwara, the Guru's Gate.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਚੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾਵਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
lines.transliteration: kahai naanak sache saahib jiu bhaavai tivai chalaavahe ||15||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, O my True Lord and Master, you make us walk according to Your Will. ||15||

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਹੁ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ehu sohilaa sabad suhaavaa ||
lines.translation: This song of praise is the Shabad, the most beautiful Word of God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੋ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabado suhaavaa sadaa sohilaa satiguroo sunaaiaa ||
lines.translation: This beauteous Shabad is the everlasting song of praise, spoken by the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਹੁ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਜਿਨ ਧੁਰਹੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਆਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: ehu tin kai ma(n)n vasiaa jin dhurahu likhiaa aaiaa ||
lines.translation: This is enshrined in the minds of those who are so pre-destined by the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਘਨੇਰੇ ਕਰਹਿ ਗਲਾ ਗਲੀ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik phirahi ghanere karahi galaa galee kinai na paaiaa ||
lines.translation: Some wander around, babbling on and on, but none obtain Him by babbling.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ॥੧੬॥
lines.transliteration: kahai naanak sabad sohilaa satiguroo sunaaiaa ||16||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, the Shabad, this song of praise, has been spoken by the True Guru. ||16||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਵਿਤੁ ਹੋਏ ਸੇ ਜਨਾ ਜਿਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: pavit hoe se janaa jinee har dhiaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Those humble beings who meditate on the Lord become pure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਹੋਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: har dhiaaiaa pavit hoe guramukh jinee dhiaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Meditating on the Lord, they become pure; as Gurmukh, they meditate on Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਵਿਤੁ ਮਾਤਾ ਪਿਤਾ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਹਿਤ ਸਿਉ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਬਾਈਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: pavit maataa pitaa kuta(n)b sahit siu pavit sa(n)gat sabaaeeaa ||
lines.translation: They are pure, along with their mothers, fathers, family and friends; all their companions are pure as well.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਦੇ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਸੁਣਦੇ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਸੇ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahade pavit sunade pavit se pavit jinee ma(n)n vasaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Pure are those who speak, and pure are those who listen; those who enshrine it within their minds are pure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸੇ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੧੭॥
lines.transliteration: kahai naanak se pavit jinee guramukh har har dhiaaiaa ||17||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, pure and holy are those who, as Gurmukh, meditate on the Lord, Har, Har. ||17||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਮੀ ਸਹਜੁ ਨ ਊਪਜੈ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਹਜੈ ਸਹਸਾ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: karamee sahaj na oopajai vin sahajai sahasaa na jaai ||
lines.translation: By religious rituals, intuitive poise is not found; without intuitive poise, skepticism does not depart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਹ ਜਾਇ ਸਹਸਾ ਕਿਤੈ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਰਹੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: nah jaai sahasaa kitai sa(n)jam rahe karam kamaae ||
lines.translation: Skepticism does not depart by contrived actions; everybody is tired of performing these rituals.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਸੈ ਜੀਉ ਮਲੀਣੁ ਹੈ ਕਿਤੁ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਧੋਤਾ ਜਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: sahasai jeeu maleen hai kit sa(n)jam dhotaa jaae ||
lines.translation: The soul is polluted by skepticism; how can it be cleansed?

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੰਨੁ ਧੋਵਹੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਾਗਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰਹਹੁ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ma(n)n dhovahu sabad laagahu har siu rahahu chit laai ||
lines.translation: Wash your mind by attaching it to the Shabad, and keep your consciousness focused on the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸਹਜੁ ਉਪਜੈ ਇਹੁ ਸਹਸਾ ਇਵ ਜਾਇ ॥੧੮॥
lines.transliteration: kahai naanak gur parasaadee sahaj upajai ihu sahasaa iv jaai ||18||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, by Guru's Grace, intuitive poise is produced, and this skepticism is dispelled. ||18||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਅਹੁ ਮੈਲੇ ਬਾਹਰਹੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ॥
lines.transliteration: jeeahu maile baaharahu niramal ||
lines.translation: Inwardly polluted, and outwardly pure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਹਰਹੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੀਅਹੁ ਤ ਮੈਲੇ ਤਿਨੀ ਜਨਮੁ ਜੂਐ ਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: baaharahu niramal jeeahu ta maile tinee janam jooai haariaa ||
lines.translation: Those who are outwardly pure and yet polluted within, lose their lives in the gamble.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਹ ਤਿਸਨਾ ਵਡਾ ਰੋਗੁ ਲਗਾ ਮਰਣੁ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: eh tisanaa vadaa rog lagaa maran manahu visaariaa ||
lines.translation: They contract this terrible disease of desire, and in their minds, they forget about dying.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵੇਦਾ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਤਮੁ ਸੋ ਸੁਣਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਜਿਉ ਬੇਤਾਲਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: vedaa mahi naam utam so sunahi naahee phirahi jiu betaaliaa ||
lines.translation: In the Vedas, the ultimate objective is the Naam, the Name of the Lord; but they do not hear this, and they wander around like demons.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਿਨ ਸਚੁ ਤਜਿਆ ਕੂੜੇ ਲਾਗੇ ਤਿਨੀ ਜਨਮੁ ਜੂਐ ਹਾਰਿਆ ॥੧੯॥
lines.transliteration: kahai naanak jin sach tajiaa kooRe laage tinee janam jooai haariaa ||19||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, those who forsake Truth and cling to falsehood, lose their lives in the gamble. ||19||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਅਹੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬਾਹਰਹੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ॥
lines.transliteration: jeeahu niramal baaharahu niramal ||
lines.translation: Inwardly pure, and outwardly pure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਹਰਹੁ ਤ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੀਅਹੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਕਰਣੀ ਕਮਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: baaharahu ta niramal jeeahu niramal satigur te karanee kamaanee ||
lines.translation: Those who are outwardly pure and also pure within, through the Guru, perform good deeds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੂੜ ਕੀ ਸੋਇ ਪਹੁਚੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਮਨਸਾ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: kooR kee soi pahuchai naahee manasaa sach samaanee ||
lines.translation: Not even an iota of falsehood touches them; their hopes are absorbed in the Truth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਖਟਿਆ ਭਲੇ ਸੇ ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: janam ratan jinee khatiaa bhale se vanajaare ||
lines.translation: Those who earn the jewel of this human life, are the most excellent of merchants.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਿਨ ਮੰਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਰਹਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਲੇ ॥੨੦॥
lines.transliteration: kahai naanak jin ma(n)n niramal sadaa rahahi gur naale ||20||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, those whose minds are pure, abide with the Guru forever. ||20||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਸਿਖੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਸੇਤੀ ਸਨਮੁਖੁ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: je ko sikh guroo setee sanamukh hovai ||
lines.translation: If a Sikh turns to the Guru with sincere faith, as sunmukh

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੋਵੈ ਤ ਸਨਮੁਖੁ ਸਿਖੁ ਕੋਈ ਜੀਅਹੁ ਰਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: hovai ta sanamukh sikh koee jeeahu rahai gur naale ||
lines.translation: if a Sikh turns to the Guru with sincere faith, as sunmukh, his soul abides with the Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਧਿਆਏ ਅੰਤਰ ਆਤਮੈ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur ke charan hiradai dhiaae a(n)tar aatamai samaale ||
lines.translation: Within his heart, he meditates on the lotus feet of the Guru; deep within his soul, he contemplates Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਛਡਿ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਪਰਣੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap chhad sadaa rahai paranai gur bin avar na jaanai koe ||
lines.translation: Renouncing selfishness and conceit, he remains always on the side of the Guru; he does not know anyone except the Guru.
